releases.title: A deeper agent, Search Console and everyday SEO tools
items: The agent gains eleven built-in SEO skills, a searchable skills library you can export and import, and a Reasoning setting for every turn.
Gemini and Grok models on the AI Gateway route, and a catalogue of presets for adding MCP servers.
Readability shows long and difficult sentences and complex words, scores Spanish, French and German, and can highlight hard sentences on the page.
Search Console: any date range, country and device filters, and URL Inspection of the page you are on.
AI readiness: a 0 to 100 score from crawler rules, probes, pre-render coverage and llms.txt, an on-device page type, and opt-in AI checks.
Copy 24 page values, export images, headings and speed as CSV, and highlight internal or external links, lazy images or a keyphrase.
Devtools export the network log as HAR or CSV and show local and session storage; the Inspector searches the page and shows its source.
Turn CSS or cookies off and override location for one tab, annotate and crop screenshots, search, rename and archive agent chats, and attach other tabs to a chat.
Resizable panes, panel pins, history retention, a Help menu, a keyboard shortcuts screen, What's New and a setup checklist on the new tab.
